subject: Sampling rate from header not recognized: g.inspectfile.R

messages.author: 42e46cfeb9067366
messages.subject: Sampling rate from header not recognized: g.inspectfile.R
parts:
Dear all,

I am having trouble with GGIR reading sampling frequencies from raw csv headers. The issue seems to have come from g.inspectfile.R, where read.myacc.csv() successfully reads in Pursercsvformat, but the Pursercsvformat$header$sample_rate fails to grab the sampling frequency from the header.

Could anyone please help me resolve this? 

Many thanks,
Grace

thank you for identifying and tracking down this error! We'll have it resolved soon, I'll keep you posted.

-Lena

This issue is now resolved. Please update GGIR to the latest release (3.0-6, from this morning) and the problem will go away.
Thank you for all your work narrowing down the cause of the error!

-Lena
